description: This dashboard provides a comprehensive overview of your Zilliz Cloud cluster's health across several key areas: resource utilization, performance, and data volume. You can clone this template dashboard and make changes by adding your own graph widgets or removing components. (cloned)
title: Zilliz Cloud Dashboard

definition.content:
![alt text](https://assets.zilliz.com/Zilliz_Logo_65f122536f.svg)


This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of your cluster's performance across several key areas:
- Resource metrics: Monitor CU computation and capacity, and storage consumption.
- Performance metrics: Track queries per second (QPS), vectors per second (VPS),  latency, and request failure rate for both read and write operations.
- Data metrics: Monitor your collection count, entity count, and loaded entities.
